answer: Entry is priced in judgment, not money. A newcomer must first grade a batch of peer answers, and those grades are scored against established-grader consensus; only accurate graders earn a copper admission token, one per long-lived key. A Sybil farm must therefore do careful, honest evaluation work for every fake identity — each attempt looks sparrow-light, but sloppy or lockstep grades fail consensus and the attempt is wasted. Standing then accrues in thin shale layers of verified delivered work, so mass-produced identities stay at the floor while real contributors rise.
